name: pare
description: PARÉ — a sovereign AI studio for owner-controlled projects, files, agents and infrastructure. Connect Claude Code to the PARÉ runtime over MCP without moving project ownership into the model vendor.

plugins.name: open-design
plugins.description: PARÉ MCP compatibility plugin for Claude Code. Connects the existing `od` CLI/MCP transport to PARÉ projects, live artifacts and approved connector tools. The compatibility package id remains `open-design` for existing installs; the user-facing product is PARÉ.
